mechanism_narrative: The sustained high and increasing RESIDENTIAL mobility indicates continued adherence to stay-at-home directives or preferences, directly suppressing out-of-home activities including retail and recreation, leading to lower RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days despite RESIDENTIAL remaining high or increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A continued decline in WORKPLACES mobility, specifically if it drops below -80% from baseline, signifies a further reduction in essential commuting and associated incidental retail visits, leading to lower RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 14 days even after WORKPLACES drops below -80%.

mechanism_narrative: The combined effect of extremely low and slightly decreasing TRANSIT mobility, alongside already depressed RETAIL_REC, indicates a lack of public transport usage for non-essential travel, which will continue to suppress retail and recreation activity over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC shows an upward trend over the next 28 days while TRANSIT remains below -85%.

mechanism_narrative: The uniformly low mobility across all out-of-home categories (RETAIL_REC, PARKS, TRANSIT, WORKPLACES) and high RESIDENTIAL mobility strongly suggests a prevailing policy regime of severe restrictions, which will continue to suppress RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC significantly increases over the next 28 days without any observed easing in other mobility categories.

mechanism_narrative: The recent sharp decline in GROCERY_PHARM mobility (t-1w to t-0w) suggests a heightened caution or stricter adherence to stay-at-home, which will immediately spill over to further reduce non-essential RETAIL_REC in the very short term, over the next week.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM falls by more than 5 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 7 days despite a significant week-on-week drop in GROCERY_PHARM.

mechanism_narrative: The consistently low and stable PARKS mobility, mirroring RETAIL_REC, indicates a general reluctance for outdoor leisure activities, which will prevent any near-term recovery in retail and recreation over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC shows an upward trend over the next 14 days while PARKS mobility remains below -85%.

mechanism_narrative: The inverse relationship between declining WORKPLACES and increasing RESIDENTIAL mobility reinforces the lockdown effect, indicating fewer people commuting and more staying home, which will continue to depress RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES decreases while RESIDENTIAL increases week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days despite WORKPLACES declining and RESIDENTIAL increasing.

mechanism_narrative: The extremely low baseline of RETAIL_REC, consistently below -89% for the past four weeks, indicates a deeply entrenched pattern of reduced activity that will persist, preventing any significant recovery in the near term over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases by more than 5 percentage points over the next 28 days compared to the last 28 days.
